gate.rule: every rep defined and |z| <= the Bonferroni critical value; z is (mean - truth) / (SD / sqrt(reps)) against nominal truth, or mean(fit - realized) / (SD / sqrt(reps)) against realized truth

frailty_gen_censoring.criterion: stratified ACE rA defined in every rep and |mean - 0.5| < |0.308 - 0.5|
